workflow.title: Prepare to launch a food-service business
workflow.goal: Help a person identify official next steps and prepare questions and information before contacting authorities.
scope_notes: This is a draft research fixture, not a verified legal checklist.
Premises, activity, business structure, and current authority requirements can change applicability.
This pack does not determine zoning, land-use approval, building use, fire safety, or permission to trade.

requirements.title: Confirm whether a City business licence applies
requirements.summary: The City of Johannesburg lists food provision, including selling or supplying meals, takeaways, or perishable food, among activities requiring a licence. Confirm the current schedule and applicability to this business model and premises directly with the City before making a trading decision.

conditions: The proposed activity involves preparation, sale, or supply of food.
unknowns: Current licensing schedule and administrative procedure
Any exemptions or additional local conditions

user_actions.label: Confirm applicability with the City of Johannesburg
Read the City's published licensing policy and Schedule 1

requirements.title: Confirm food-premises hygiene requirements
requirements.summary: Ask the responsible local authority which food-premises hygiene requirements and Certificate of Acceptability process apply to the intended operation. The pack must not represent the process as satisfied until the current regulation and local procedure have been reviewed.

conditions: The operation handles or supplies food.
unknowns: Current local application and inspection process

user_actions.label: Ask the responsible local authority about the applicable process

requirements.title: Review CIPC registration options
requirements.summary: CIPC's BizPortal provides company registration and related services. Review the official eligibility, current fees, service terms, and company type options there; this application does not file or guarantee registration.

conditions: The person is considering a registered business entity or a related CIPC service.
unknowns: Appropriate legal form for the user's circumstances
